findings.statement: verifying the writer's own reads costs less than 25% on a cold pass
findings.detail: 4536788 ops/s verified against 4846412 unverified (unverified vs verified: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 1.068, p=0.4034) -- within noise, not a result). This is the price of the guarantee RocksDB charges by default and LMDB does not offer, on the path YCSB A through F read through

findings.statement: a warm read pays almost nothing for verification
findings.detail: warm: 6154272 ops/s verified against 5838508 unverified (1.054x). A chunk is checked once and remembered, so the cost is a property of the first touch and not of the read path -- which is why f8-checksums, measuring warm point reads, found it free

notes: both arms interleaved in one process; the only difference is Options::verify_reads
